messages:
Sam (PM): quick thread ": regional egress-inclusive pricing" — customers in EU/APAC ask for single-line invoices that include egress and regional infra costs. want to decide packaging approach.
Priya (Sales): echo. ISVs want predictable line items: either SKU with region flag or sku + regional-addon. procurement hates surprise egress bills.
Jorge (Eng): technical constraints: we can tag usage by region but cross-region routing and fallback will complicate billing attribution. also, dedicated/private customers may have different egress rules.
Camille (Finance): prefer SKU-level pricing that includes an egress cushion to avoid overrun write-offs. but risk: price rigidity vs competitive bidding. need ARR scenarios.
Derek (Legal): compliance flags: some customers need explicit data residency and egress assurances in MSA. if we bundle egress, must still allow carveouts for export-restricted customers.
infra-bot: created ticket PRO-4501 region-billing-attribution
Sam (PM): options: 1) region-tagged SKUs (e.g., pro-eu, pro-us) with different list prices, 2) base SKU + regional addon (flat monthly), 3) token-based base SKU + inclusive egress band with overage. pros/cons?
Priya (Sales): 1 best for sales simplicity. 2 better for flexibility when deals cross regions. 3 risky for enterprise POs.
Jorge (Eng): cost to implement: option1 minimal billing changes but requires model catalog mapping per-region. option2 needs addon pipeline. option3 requires per-token egress metering + overage flows. estimates: 1 sprint for 1, 3 sprints for 2, 4 sprints for 3.
Camille (Finance): short-term recommendation: pilot option1 for hosted (pro-eu / pro-us) and option2 for Dedicated/Private customers. modelled ARR: inclusive-eu price = base + 12% egress premium. will share sheet by EOD.
Derek (Legal): add carveout clause for export-restricted customers and include termination rights if region compliance breached. will draft.
Sam (PM): Launch gating checklist (pilot): docs, pricebook entries, billing tests, 2 pilot contracts (one EU hosted, one US hosted), legal clause, telemetry to show region attribution accuracy >99%
Priya (Sales): lining up pilots: Acme EU (hosted) and RetailCo US (hosted). will confirm next week
Jorge (Eng): infra note: need to ensure CDN egress attribution mapping matches billing sources; will spin up mapping job and sample report. proto config below:
```
region_pricing_map:
  pro-us:
    base_price: 499
    egress_premium_pct: 12
  pro-eu:
    base_price: 559
    egress_premium_pct: 12
```
Camille (Finance): if pilot shows >5% variance between infra cost and charged premium, we reassess. will run stress scenarios.
infra-bot: billing smoke tests queued for sandbox orgs
Sam (PM): decision: pilot region-tagged SKUs for hosted first; defer inclusive-overage experiments until we have better egress telemetry. GA only after pilot metrics and legal language validated (target Q4). assign follow-ups in PRO tracker.
Derek (Legal): I'll post draft MSA addendum to #legal-drafts by EOD
Camille (Finance): posting ARR model link: https://sheets.redwood/regional-pricing-pilot
Priya (Sales): thanks team — I'll sync with pilots and surface procurement PO examples we need
Jorge (Eng): opening RFC + ticket PRO-4501, will attach prototype mapping CSV
Sam (PM): thanks all :thumbsup: end.
